_what: The dials. A run's controls.json overrides any of these; nothing else changes how an edit behaves.

whole.what: a take is never cut inside: the cut falls between shots, a breath (0.15 s) between two lines (V15)

pace.what: how the cut breathes. `value` set (here or in a run's controls.json) = that option for every take; null = the format's own (`by_format`, a format names its own when its playbook says so), else `default`. `max_pause` null = a take is never cut inside (V15, 2026-10-20: "cuts between shots (never mid-breath)"); a number = the longest silence left inside a take, the old pause cutter (2026-09-20), kept only for a run that asks for it. `dead_air_s`: a silence between two lines longer than this is flagged by the listen (listen.py).

pauses.what: every mid-clip pause this long or longer (and every one the pace dial cuts) is marked on the live timeline's Pauses lane, cut or kept, for the owner to review there (T-3, 23 Sep: no separate stop); shorter gaps are breaths and are always kept

caption_look.what: a row id from looks/bank.json, or 'match-swipe'; null = picked by the piece's format, else the app it pretends to be made in, else the default — looks/bank.json `pick` (V13; the one map since 2026-10-21, E6)

sound.what: THE ONE LOUDNESS TABLE (2026-10-21, E27 — the edit-map line's looks/edit-looks.json `mix` folded in): music sits 18 dB under the voice and comes up to its gap level only where nobody speaks; a sound effect lands two frames before its picture; room tone sits at room_tone_db under the trimmed joins and silent spans — ONLY when the swipe or the brief calls for room sound (V14). Music, effects and room tone are never assumed (V14, C10).

transition.what: a row id from looks/transitions.json; a hard cut is the default

stills.what: a still picture never sits frozen: slow push or drift, direction alternating

safe_zone.what: the strictest of the surfaces this piece runs on (safe_zones.surfaces × platform_surfaces) — where the app's own buttons cover the frame; captions and overlays stay out. Kept for rows that still carry a raw y_pct; every text layer now names a zone in looks/placement.json

outputs.what: 9:16 only (the owner, 2026-09-23). No 4:5 or 1:1 file is ever made

mix.what: the finished file is mastered to −14 LUFS integrated with peaks no higher than −1 dBTP

grade.what: a row id from looks/grades.json — one grade over the whole picture, never over the text

content_4x5.what: the 22 Sep rule: the 9:16 frame is generated with its content in the centred 4:5 band (1080×1350 of 1080×1920) — nothing that matters sits above 14.84% or below 85.16%

tiktok.what: top: Following / For You bar and search; bottom: handle, caption, sound line and the ad's CTA button; right: avatar, like, comment, save, share rail

instagram-reels.what: top: Reels title and camera; bottom: handle, caption, audio; right: like, comment, share, more

meta-reels-ads.what: Meta's own guidance for Reels ads: keep the top 14% and bottom 35% free of text and logos — the sponsored label, CTA button and ad copy sit there; right: the reel's icon rail

youtube-shorts.what: top: search and menu; bottom: channel, title, subscribe and product shelf; right: like, dislike, comment, share, remix rail

meta-stories.what: Meta's Stories guidance: 14% top (profile, progress bar) and 20% bottom (reply bar / CTA) free

safe_zones.what: 9:16 only (the owner, 2026-09-23: "I do not want 4:5 or 1:1 videos at all"). Per platform surface, measured from each app's own layout — approximate, draft, re-measure when an app changes. The edit uses the strictest of the surfaces in platform_surfaces; every zone in looks/placement.json sits inside it and inside the content 4:5 band

cutdowns.what: seconds; the lowest-priority whole scenes come out first, a line is never cut mid-scene, priority 1 and the opener never come out

platform_surfaces.what: the feeds this piece will run in; the safe box is the strictest of them. Organic by default (the owner, 2026-09-23: organic posts, not ads) — add meta-reels-ads etc. only for a paid run

moves.what: the camera moves the edit may add by itself (V15, 2026-10-20: "no unneeded zoom-ins or punch-ins"). push_stills: a slow push over a still-looking video shot (off). punch: where a jump cut is punched in — `swipe` = only where the swipe itself pushes in (frame_control push_in), `never`. image_drift: how far a still PICTURE (a plate, a photo) drifts so it is never frozen. A format turns one on here when its swipe calls for it.
